secoes.titulo: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência
2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões
3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão
4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem
5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questoes.enunciado:
The city library will open one hour earlier on weekdays beginning in June. Weekend hours will remain unchanged, and the children’s room will still close at 6 p.m.

According to the notice, what will change in June?
alternativas: The library's weekday opening time.
The library's closing time every day.
The schedule of the children's room on weekends.
The number of books available for borrowing.
The library's weekend opening time.
questoes.explicacao: O aviso informa expressamente que a biblioteca abrirá uma hora mais cedo nos dias úteis. Os horários do fim de semana não serão alterados, e nada se afirma sobre acervo ou sobre mudança do encerramento diário.

questoes.enunciado:
Mara submitted her application on Monday. By Thursday, she had received no confirmation, although two colleagues who applied later had already heard back. She decided to contact the admissions office.

What can reasonably be inferred about Mara?
alternativas: She knows that her application has been rejected.
She is concerned about the lack of confirmation.
She applied after both of her colleagues.
She plans to withdraw her application immediately.
She received a confirmation but lost the email.
questoes.explicacao: A decisão de contatar o setor, após observar respostas a candidatos posteriores, sugere preocupação com a ausência de confirmação. O texto não permite concluir rejeição, desistência nem recebimento prévio de mensagem.

questoes.enunciado:
A recent survey of 600 commuters found that most respondents valued reliable bus arrivals more than free onboard Wi-Fi. The survey did not ask whether they would be willing to pay higher fares for improved service.

Which conclusion is supported by the survey?
alternativas: All commuters would accept a fare increase.
Wi-Fi access was considered useless by every respondent.
Respondents placed greater value on punctual buses than on free Wi-Fi.
Higher fares are necessary to improve arrival times.
The survey established the views of every commuter in the city.
questoes.explicacao: O levantamento identifica uma preferência relativa pela confiabilidade dos ônibus em comparação ao Wi-Fi gratuito. Não investigou disposição para pagar mais, tampouco autoriza generalizar a todos os usuários da cidade.

questoes.enunciado:
To reduce food waste, the cafeteria now serves smaller standard portions but allows customers to request a second helping at no extra charge. Staff say that fewer plates return with uneaten food.

What is the main idea of the passage?
alternativas: The cafeteria has removed second helpings from its menu.
Customers must pay more to receive enough food.
Staff are required to weigh all returned plates.
A change in portion policy is associated with less discarded food.
The cafeteria has stopped serving standard portions.
questoes.explicacao: A ideia central liga porções iniciais menores, com repetição gratuita disponível, à diminuição das sobras relatada pela equipe. As demais afirmações contradizem a política descrita ou acrescentam exigências inexistentes.

questoes.enunciado:
Although the company expanded its online store last year, most of its sales still came from physical locations. Managers expect digital sales to grow, but they have not announced plans to close any shops.

Which statement best reflects the passage?
alternativas: Online sales were the company's only source of income.
All physical stores are scheduled to close.
The online store was abandoned after its launch.
Management confirmed a date for closing the shops.
Physical stores remained the leading sales channel last year.
questoes.explicacao: O contraste introduzido por 'although' indica que a expansão digital não tirou das lojas físicas a liderança nas vendas. A expectativa de crescimento on-line não equivale a um anúncio de encerramento das unidades.

questoes.enunciado:
During the pilot program, employees could choose to work remotely on Fridays. Participation was optional, and workers in customer-facing roles needed their supervisors' approval before joining.

Who could participate without first obtaining the specific approval mentioned?
alternativas: Eligible workers who were not in customer-facing roles.
Every employee who served customers in person.
Only employees who had worked remotely before.
Anyone willing to work from home all week.
No employee, because participation was mandatory.
questoes.explicacao: O requisito explícito de autorização do supervisor recai sobre quem exerce atendimento ao público. Para os demais, o texto não impõe essa aprovação específica; participar era opcional e limitado às sextas-feiras.

questoes.enunciado:
After a series of delays, the research team released preliminary findings rather than its full report. The authors stressed that the figures might change once the remaining data were checked.

What should readers avoid assuming?
alternativas: That some data still need checking.
That the preliminary figures are final.
That the full report has not yet been released.
That the team acknowledged possible revisions.
That the reported findings are preliminary.
questoes.explicacao: Os pesquisadores apresentam resultados preliminares e avisam que os números podem mudar após a conferência dos dados restantes. Tratá-los como definitivos ignora essa ressalva; as demais leituras são expressamente sustentadas.

questoes.enunciado:
Students who missed the first workshop may watch a recording before attending the second session. However, the recording does not replace the short assessment required of all participants.

A student who missed the first workshop must still
alternativas: attend a new first workshop in person.
pay a fee to access the recording.
complete the short assessment.
skip the second session altogether.
submit a second recording of the workshop.
questoes.explicacao: O texto afirma que a gravação pode ajudar quem faltou, mas não dispensa a avaliação exigida de todos. Não há previsão de taxa, reapresentação presencial da primeira oficina ou impedimento à segunda sessão.

questoes.enunciado:
The committee described the proposal as 'feasible', provided that the existing staff could be trained within three months.

In this context, 'feasible' is closest in meaning to
alternativas: mandatory.
unpopular.
already completed.
practicable.
financially profitable.
questoes.explicacao: 'Feasible' qualifica algo que pode ser realizado, sob a condição de capacitação da equipe. O termo não expressa obrigação, rejeição, execução concluída nem lucratividade, sentidos que dependeriam de outras informações.

questoes.enunciado:
The editor asked the journalist to 'look into' the discrepancy between the two figures before publishing the article.

The expression 'look into' means to
alternativas: ignore.
translate.
illustrate.
approve without checking.
investigate.
questoes.explicacao: No contexto de divergência entre números, 'look into' significa examinar ou investigar o problema. A orientação ocorre antes da publicação e não se confunde com ignorar, traduzir, ilustrar ou aprovar sem conferir.

questoes.enunciado:
The manager said that the new office would 'eventually' accommodate all regional teams, even though only one department would move there this year.

The word 'eventually' indicates that the move will happen
alternativas: at some point in the future.
by chance and without planning.
only if an emergency occurs.
immediately after the announcement.
occasionally, but never on a regular basis.
questoes.explicacao: 'Eventually' indica um resultado esperado em algum momento futuro, não 'eventualmente' no sentido de possibilidade ocasional. A mudança parcial neste ano reforça a realização gradual, sem afirmar acaso ou urgência.

questoes.enunciado:
The company issued a 'comprehensive' guide covering recruitment, onboarding, payroll and workplace safety.

In the passage, 'comprehensive' suggests that the guide is
alternativas: difficult to obtain.
wide-ranging.
brief and incomplete.
strictly confidential.
written only for financial experts.
questoes.explicacao: A enumeração de diferentes assuntos mostra que 'comprehensive' significa abrangente. O adjetivo não indica sigilo, dificuldade de acesso, brevidade ou restrição a especialistas em finanças, sentidos não apoiados pelo contexto.

questoes.enunciado:
During the negotiations, both sides agreed to 'meet halfway' on the delivery schedule instead of insisting on their original deadlines.

The expression 'meet halfway' conveys the idea of
alternativas: ending the negotiation without agreement.
sharing a ride to the delivery site.
making mutual concessions.
meeting at the midpoint of a route.
allowing only one side to impose its deadline.
questoes.explicacao: 'Meet halfway' é expressão idiomática para chegar a um compromisso com concessões recíprocas. A referência aos prazos originais afastados impede a leitura literal de encontro geográfico ou imposição unilateral.

questoes.enunciado:
The applicant was asked to provide 'actual' expenses for the trip, not rough estimates prepared before departure.

The adjective 'actual' refers to expenses that were
alternativas: expected next year.
updated every hour.
approved in advance.
really incurred.
unrelated to the journey.
questoes.explicacao: 'Actual expenses' são gastos efetivamente realizados, em oposição às estimativas anteriores à viagem. O falso cognato não significa simplesmente 'atuais' ou atualizados; tampouco pressupõe aprovação antecipada.

questoes.enunciado:
The consultant warned that cutting the training budget could 'backfire' if avoidable mistakes later became more frequent.

Here, 'backfire' means to
alternativas: guarantee immediate savings without side effects.
increase the number of training sessions.
make a policy legally unenforceable.
delay a plan without affecting its results.
produce an outcome opposite to what was intended.
questoes.explicacao: 'Backfire' descreve efeito contraproducente: a economia pretendida pode gerar mais erros e custos indiretos. Não significa assegurar poupança, aumentar treinamentos nem apenas retardar a execução da medida.

questoes.enunciado:
The supervisor called the intern's suggestion 'sensible' because it reduced unnecessary steps without adding risks.

In this passage, 'sensible' is best understood as
alternativas: reasonable.
highly emotional.
easily offended.
physically sensitive.
unrelated to practical judgment.
questoes.explicacao: 'Sensible' caracteriza a proposta como razoável e prudente, pois reduz etapas sem elevar riscos. Em português, a semelhança com 'sensível' pode induzir erro, mas o contexto trata de julgamento prático.

questoes.enunciado:
When the auditors arrived, the finance team had already corrected the spreadsheet.

What does the past perfect indicate?
alternativas: The correction will occur after the auditors leave.
The correction preceded the auditors' arrival.
The auditors corrected the spreadsheet themselves.
Both actions necessarily took place at the same instant.
The finance team had not begun the correction.
questoes.explicacao: O past perfect em 'had already corrected' marca uma ação concluída antes de outro ponto passado, a chegada dos auditores. Não transfere a correção aos auditores nem indica simultaneidade ou ação futura.

questoes.enunciado:
Employees must wear identification badges in the laboratory, but they may leave them in their lockers when working in the public reception area.

What distinction do the modal verbs establish?
alternativas: An obligation to wear badges in every part of the building.
A prohibition against storing badges in lockers.
A requirement in one location and permission in another.
A mere suggestion to wear badges in the laboratory.
A statement that no identification rules exist.
questoes.explicacao: 'Must' impõe o uso de crachá no laboratório, enquanto 'may' concede permissão para deixá-lo no armário na recepção pública. Confundir obrigação com sugestão ou permissão com proibição distorce a regra.

questoes.enunciado:
If the supplier delivers the parts by Friday, the engineers will finish the prototype next week.

The sentence presents completion next week as
alternativas: guaranteed regardless of the supplier's actions.
an event that was completed last week.
impossible even if the parts arrive in time.
dependent on delivery by Friday.
dependent on the engineers having finished yesterday.
questoes.explicacao: O primeiro condicional relaciona uma condição possível no futuro — entrega até sexta — ao resultado previsto na semana seguinte. A frase não assegura o resultado incondicionalmente nem descreve fato consumado.

questoes.enunciado:
The software may have deleted the temporary files during the update. The support team is still checking the logs.

What degree of certainty does 'may have deleted' express?
alternativas: Proof that deletion definitely occurred.
A command to delete the files now.
A promise that no files were removed.
An ability that the software will acquire later.
A possibility concerning a past event.
questoes.explicacao: 'May have' seguido de particípio indica possibilidade relativa a fato passado, não certeza. A análise dos registros ainda em curso confirma a cautela; o enunciado tampouco expressa ordem ou promessa.

questoes.enunciado:
The new policy was introduced in April. It was revised two months later because several employees found its instructions unclear.

To what does the pronoun 'It' refer?
alternativas: The new policy.
April.
The employees.
Two months.
The instructions alone.
questoes.explicacao: O pronome 'It' retoma 'the new policy', que foi implementada e, posteriormente, revisada. A referência coesiva é singular e compatível com o objeto de revisão; mês e empregados não exercem esse papel.

questoes.enunciado:
Had the technician checked the connection earlier, the outage might have been avoided.

The sentence implies that
alternativas: the connection was definitely checked before the outage.
the technician did not check the connection early enough.
the outage will certainly be avoided tomorrow.
the technician has no responsibility for checking connections.
the outage was impossible under any circumstances.
questoes.explicacao: A inversão 'Had ... checked' equivale a 'If ... had checked', formando condição hipotética sobre o passado não realizado. 'Might have been avoided' aponta possibilidade, não garantia de evitar a falha.

questoes.enunciado:
The board has been reviewing the proposal since January, but no final decision has been made.

Which interpretation is consistent with the verb forms?
alternativas: The review ended before January.
The board made a final decision in January.
The review began in January and remains relevant now.
The board will start its first review next year.
The proposal has already been permanently rejected.
questoes.explicacao: O present perfect continuous com 'since January' indica atividade iniciada naquele mês e com continuidade ou efeito no presente. A voz passiva negativa informa que ainda não houve decisão final.

questoes.enunciado:
The maintenance window was extended; therefore, customers could not access the platform until 3 a.m.

The connector 'therefore' signals
alternativas: an example unrelated to maintenance.
a contrast with the preceding statement.
a correction denying that maintenance occurred.
a consequence of the extended maintenance window.
a condition under which maintenance would be canceled.
questoes.explicacao: 'Therefore' introduz consequência lógica: a ampliação da manutenção explica a indisponibilidade até as três horas. Não sinaliza oposição, exemplo, negação do evento anterior ou condição hipotética.

questoes.enunciado:
Our town has plenty of parking spaces. What it lacks is a safe way for children to walk to school. Before building another car park, we should repair the sidewalks.

What is the writer's primary purpose?
alternativas: To list the town's parking fees.
To describe a completed road repair project.
To announce a ban on children walking to school.
To prove that no resident uses a car.
To argue for prioritizing sidewalk repairs.
questoes.explicacao: O autor contrasta a oferta de estacionamento com a falta de segurança para pedestres e defende consertar calçadas antes de ampliar vagas. Trata-se de argumentação propositiva, não anúncio de obras concluídas.

questoes.enunciado:
The new filing system was advertised as 'effortless'. After three hours of resetting passwords and calling support, the staff finally managed to log in.

The quotation marks around 'effortless' help create a tone of
alternativas: irony.
admiration without reservation.
formal celebration.
complete indifference.
scientific neutrality about the system.
questoes.explicacao: As aspas em 'effortless', contrastadas com as horas gastas em problemas de acesso, produzem ironia sobre a promessa de facilidade. Não se trata de elogio literal nem de relato neutro sem avaliação implícita.

questoes.enunciado:
First, the report outlines the causes of urban flooding. It then examines three engineering solutions and ends by comparing their costs and environmental impacts.

How is the report organized?
alternativas: From a personal anecdote to a fictional ending.
From causes to solutions and then comparison.
From financial results to a list of employee benefits.
From legal penalties to unrelated historical dates.
From conclusions directly to an unexplained quotation.
questoes.explicacao: Os marcadores 'First', 'then' e 'ends' descrevem uma sequência clara: causas, possíveis soluções e comparação de impactos. As outras estruturas introduzem tópicos ou gêneros que o excerto não apresenta.

questoes.enunciado:
'The deadline is approaching like a train with no brakes,' the project leader said as the team prepared for the final review.

The comparison suggests that the deadline feels
alternativas: distant and unlikely to matter.
easy to postpone without consequences.
fast-approaching and difficult to stop.
literally connected to railway scheduling.
irrelevant because the review was canceled.
questoes.explicacao: A comparação explícita com um trem sem freios reforça urgência e sensação de avanço inevitável do prazo. É linguagem figurada, não referência a uma ferrovia ou prova de que o encontro foi cancelado.

questoes.enunciado:
Some critics say that online meetings always reduce collaboration. Yet, several teams in our study reported more frequent exchanges after introducing short daily video calls.

What is the function of 'Yet' in the passage?
alternativas: To add another example supporting the critics' absolute view.
To mark the final step in a set of instructions.
To introduce the cause of the critics' opinion.
To introduce evidence that challenges the preceding claim.
To restate the same claim with stronger wording.
questoes.explicacao: 'Yet' estabelece contraposição entre a alegação absoluta dos críticos e relatos que não a confirmam. O conectivo introduz evidência contrária, sem provar que todas as reuniões virtuais sejam benéficas.

questoes.enunciado:
This guide is intended for first-time users. It explains how to create an account, set a password and locate the main settings menu. Advanced integrations are covered in a separate manual.

Who is the intended audience of this guide?
alternativas: Developers configuring advanced integrations only.
Customers filing a complaint about service charges.
Auditors examining financial statements.
Users who already know every system function.
People beginning to use the system.
questoes.explicacao: O guia declara ser voltado a 'first-time users' e aborda operações iniciais de cadastro e configuração. Integrações avançadas estão em outro manual; o público-alvo não são apenas profissionais especializados.

questoes.enunciado:
Reducing paper use will not solve every environmental problem in the office. Nevertheless, it is an inexpensive first step that staff can take immediately.

Which description best fits the author's stance?
alternativas: Supportive but aware of the measure's limitations.
Dismissive of every attempt to reduce paper use.
Convinced that paper reduction solves all environmental issues.
Uncertain whether staff can act without major investment.
Opposed to immediate low-cost environmental actions.
questoes.explicacao: O autor reconhece que a medida não resolve todos os problemas, mas a recomenda como começo barato e imediato. O tom é favorável e ponderado; não há rejeição da iniciativa nem promessa de solução integral.

questoes.enunciado:
The first paragraph presents a question about declining customer satisfaction. The next two paragraphs analyze survey responses, while the final paragraph proposes changes to support procedures.

The final paragraph mainly serves to
alternativas: introduce an entirely new topic with no connection to the survey.
recommend actions based on the preceding analysis.
repeat the original question without responding to it.
replace the survey findings with a fictional story.
explain how the survey sample was first selected.
questoes.explicacao: A organização enunciada culmina em recomendações para o atendimento após análise dos questionários. Assim, o parágrafo final transforma o diagnóstico em propostas, e não abre tema desvinculado ou apenas repete a questão.

questoes.enunciado:
IT NOTICE: Scheduled maintenance will take place on Sunday from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC. Users may experience intermittent access during this window. No action is required before maintenance begins.

What should users understand from the notice?
alternativas: All users must reinstall the software before Sunday.
Access will certainly be unavailable for the entire day.
Service access may be unstable during the specified period.
The maintenance will begin at 03:00 UTC.
Users must submit a support request in advance.
questoes.explicacao: O aviso aponta manutenção entre 01h e 03h UTC e possibilidade de acesso intermitente nesse intervalo. Não prevê indisponibilidade durante todo o domingo nem exige reinstalação ou providência antecipada.

questoes.enunciado:
PROCUREMENT NOTE: Quotations must include delivery fees and remain valid for at least 30 days. Proposals received after 5 p.m. on 12 August will not be evaluated.

Which quotation meets the stated formal conditions?
alternativas: One that excludes shipping but remains valid for 60 days.
One that includes shipping but expires after 20 days.
One that meets all price conditions but arrives on 13 August.
One that includes shipping, is valid for 35 days and arrives before the deadline.
One that omits the validity period and arrives on time.
questoes.explicacao: A cotação aceita precisa informar frete, valer pelo menos 30 dias e chegar até o prazo indicado. A proposta com 35 dias, entrega incluída e envio tempestivo atende aos três requisitos simultaneamente.

questoes.enunciado:
HELP DESK RULE: Priority 1 incidents involve a complete outage of a critical service. A single user's inability to print while all shared services are running is classified as Priority 3.

How should the printing problem described be classified?
alternativas: As Priority 1 because any printing failure is critical.
As an incident with no classification at all.
As Priority 1 whenever the user is a manager.
As a complete outage of all critical shared services.
As a Priority 3 incident.
questoes.explicacao: A regra distingue interrupção integral de serviço crítico, de prioridade 1, de falha individual de impressão com serviços compartilhados operantes, classificada como prioridade 3. Cargo do usuário não é critério mencionado.

questoes.enunciado:
HR MEMO: Staff members may carry over up to five unused vacation days into the next calendar year, provided that their managers approve the request by 15 December.

Under the memo, carrying over vacation days requires
alternativas: managerial approval by the stated date.
automatic transfer of all unused days.
a minimum of six unused days.
approval only after the new year begins.
proof that the employee worked on every weekend.
questoes.explicacao: A transferência é limitada a cinco dias e condicionada à aprovação da chefia até 15 de dezembro. O verbo 'may' não torna o benefício automático; também não impõe mínimo de seis dias nem exigências de fins de semana.

questoes.enunciado:
SECURITY GUIDELINE: Password-reset links expire 20 minutes after issuance. If a link has expired, request a new one; do not reuse the old message.

What is the recommended procedure after expiration?
alternativas: Try the expired link repeatedly until it works.
Request another password-reset link.
Send the old link to a colleague for activation.
Turn off account security checks permanently.
Assume the account is deleted and cannot be recovered.
questoes.explicacao: A diretriz determina solicitar novo link quando o anterior expira após 20 minutos, sem reutilizar a mensagem antiga. Insistir no link vencido ou repassá-lo não corresponde ao procedimento indicado.

questoes.enunciado:
PROJECT UPDATE: Testing cannot start until the revised specifications are approved. The design team submitted the revisions yesterday; approval is still pending.

Which project activity is currently blocked?
alternativas: The submission of the revised specifications.
The initial preparation of the design team's revisions.
The start of testing.
The act of requesting approval in the future.
The completed approval of the revised specifications.
questoes.explicacao: O início dos testes depende da aprovação das especificações revisadas, que ainda está pendente. A equipe já enviou as revisões; portanto, não é a submissão que permanece impedida, mas a etapa de testes.

questoes.enunciado:
DATA POLICY: Archived records are available to authorized staff for audit purposes. Employees must not download copies to personal devices, even when they have permission to view the records.

Which action complies with the policy?
alternativas: An authorized employee saves the records on a private laptop.
Any visitor downloads the records to review them at home.
An employee shares archived copies through a personal account.
An authorized employee views archived records for an audit without personal downloads.
A staff member treats viewing permission as unrestricted copying permission.
questoes.explicacao: A norma permite consulta aos registros arquivados por pessoas autorizadas para fins de auditoria, mas veda downloads em aparelhos pessoais. Permissão de visualizar não se transforma em autorização irrestrita de copiar.

questoes.enunciado:
SERVICE AGREEMENT: The provider will acknowledge support tickets within four business hours. Resolution times depend on the incident category and are specified in a separate schedule.

What does the four-business-hour commitment cover?
alternativas: Final resolution of every incident within four hours.
Automatic closure of tickets that remain unanswered.
An obligation to resolve all incidents on the same calendar day.
A guarantee that response and resolution are identical steps.
Acknowledgment of a support ticket, not necessarily its resolution.
questoes.explicacao: O prazo de quatro horas úteis refere-se ao reconhecimento do chamado ('acknowledge'), não à solução definitiva. Os prazos de resolução variam por categoria e estão em outro quadro, que não foi reproduzido.
